src: Tshisinyo ya Melao.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Tshisinyo ya Molao wa 2022 wa Manyalo Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho phatlalatswa ha Tshisinyo ya Molao wa 2022 wa Manyalo bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Vukati wa Mpfapfarhuto wa 2022 Khabinete yi pasise ku kandziyisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Vukati wa Mpfapfarhuto wa 2022 leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: Tshisinyo ena e netefatsa Moralo wa Molao wa Manyalo wa Afrika Borwa o neng o tjhaelwe monwana ke Kabinete ka 2022.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu humelerisa Phepha ra Swibumabumelo swa Mfumo hi mayelana na Vukati eAfrika-Dzonga, leri ri pasisiweke hi Khabinete hi Nyenyakulu 2022.

src: Tshisinyo ena e dumella Lefapha la Ditaba tsa Lehae ho ba le Molao o le mong o laolang Manyalo naheng ena.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu havexerisa Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ku hluvukisa Nawu wa Vukati wun'we wa tiko leri.

src: Tshisinyo ena ya molao e batla ho netefatsa hore manyalo ohle a latela se ngotsweng ho Molaotheo wa Afrika Borwa wa 1996 mabapi le tekatekano, seriti sa botho ha mmoho le ho se kgethollane.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu lava ku tiyisisa leswaku vukati hinkwabyo bya hetisisiwa hi ku fambisana na milawu ya ndzingano, nkaxihlawuhlawu na xindzhuti xa ximunhu tanihilaha swi lulamiseriweke hakona eka Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ya 1996.

src: Tshisinyo ena ya molao e dumella Maafrika Borwa ohle a bong bo fapafapaneng, a tumelo ha mmoho le setso se fapafapaneng ho kena manyalong a molaong ho latela se boletsweng ke molaotheo.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowa mpfapfarhuto wu pfumelela vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga na vatshami etikweni va rimbewuvutixaxameti, xikan'we na swikhorwiwa swa vukhongeri na swa mfumo, ku hetisisa vukati bya xinawu hi ku fambisana na milawu ya le ka vumbiwa.

src: Tshisinyo ena e na le dipehelo tsa thibelo ya manyalo a bana le ho hanyetsa taba ya ho tekenwa ha lenyalo molekane e mong a le siyo.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu katsaka goza ro sivela vukati byo tanihi vukati bya vana na lebyi byi endliwaka ku ri hava vandla lerin'wana.

src: Tshisinyo ya Molao wa 2022 wa Setsi sa Naha sa Moralo wa Motheo wa Metsi (NWRIA).
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Ejensi ya Switirhisiwakulu swa Swipfuno swa Mati ya Rixaka (NWRIA) wa 2022.

src: Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho tliswa Palamenteng ha Tshisinyo ya NWRITshisinyo ena ya molao e sisinya ho thehwa ha NWRIA e tla ikarabella tabeng ya moralo, tshehetso ya ditjhelete ha mmoho le ntshetsopele ya moralo wa motheo wa metsi naheng ena.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Nawumbisi wa NWRIA wa mpfapfarhuto ePalamende.

src: E tla boela e ikarabela le tlhokomelong ya meralo e teng ha jwale ya meralo ya motheo ya metsi.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu ringanyeta ku simekiwa ka NWRIA leswaku yi va na vutihlamuleri bya nkunguhato, ku nyika timali na nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwakulu swa mati swa tiko leri.

src: Setsi sena se tla netefatsa phepelo e tsitsitseng le ya moshwelella ya metsi ho latela boitlamo bo boletsweng molaotheong wa naha hore batho ba hloka metsi le tikoloho e sireletsehileng.
tgt: Yi ta tlhela yi va na vutihlamuleri bya nhlayiso wa switirhisiwakulu swa swipfuno swa mati leswi nga kona eka nkarhi wa sweswi.

src: E tla thehwa e be Khampani ya Mmuso e tlasa Lenaneo la Bobedi Molaong o Laolang Matlotlo a Setjhaba wa 1999 (Molao wa 1 wa 1999).
tgt: Ejensi leyi yi fanele ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na mphakelo wo yiseka emahlweni, wo ringanana na ku va wo tshembeka wa mati hi ku fambisana na miboheko leyi nga eka vumbiwa ya mfikelelo wa mati na ku sirhelela mbangu lowu nga na rihanyo.

src: Tshisinyo ena ya molao e tlisa diphetoho Molaong wa Tlhalano wa 1979, (Molao wa bo 70 wa 1979) ka maikemisetso a ho sireletsa bana ba sa leng banyane kapa ba manyalong a ma-Muslim ba ntseng ba hloka tlhokomelo.
tgt: Yi ta simekiwa tanihi Vandla ra Mfumo ehansi ka Xedulu ya 2 ya Nawu wa Malawulelo ya Timali ta Mfumo, 1999 (Nawu wa 1999).

src: Tse ding tsa diphetoho di kenyeletsa kabo ya mafa nakong ya tlhalano esitana le ho tingwa ha melemo ya lenyalo tlasa manyalo a ma-Muslim.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wo Dlaya Vukati 2023 Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wo Dlaya Vukati wa mpfapfarhuto wa 2023 ePalamende.

src: Ka Phuptjane 2022, Lekgotla la Molaotheo le ne le fumane hore Molao ona wa Tlhalano ha o ikamahanye le Molaotheo jwalo ka ha o qhelela ka thoko manyalo a ma-Muslim.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati, 1979 (Nawu wa 70 wa 1979) ku endlela ku lulamisela tindlela ta ku sirhelela nhlayiseko wa swihlangi kumbe va na lava hlayisiwaka va tswariweke eka vukati bya Ximuzilamu.

src: Lekgotla le ne le fumane hore karolo e itseng ya molao ona e kgetholla pakeng tsa bana ba batswadi ba nyalaneng le ba sa nyalanang.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi tlhela yi lulamisela ku phakeriwa hi vuntshwa ka rifuwo loko ku n'okisiwa vukati bya Ximuzilamu ku lulamisela ku tekeriwa mivuyelo ya ndzhaka ya vukati bya Ximuzilamu.

src: Tshisinyo ya Molao wa Tsoseletso ya Afrika le Letlole la Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba (ARF) Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho phatlalatswa ha Tshisinyo ena ya molao wa ARF bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba.
tgt: Hi Khotavuxika 2022, Khoto ya Vumbiwa yi kumile leswaku Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati eka xivumbeko xa wona xa nkarhi wa sweswi a wu fambisani na Vumbiwa tanihileswi wu nga katsiki vukati bya Ximuzilamu.

src: Maikemisetso a Tshisinyo ena ya molao ke ho tlisa diphetoho ho Molao wa ha jwale wa ARF (Molao wa bo 51 wa 2000).
tgt: Khoto yi kume leswaku xiyenge xa Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati wu hambana na vumbiwa hi mhaka ya leswaku wu endla xihlawuhlawu lexi nga riki lexinene ehenhla ka vana va vatswari lava tekaneke na vatswari lava nga tekanangiki.

src: Diphetoho tsena di tla etsa hore ARF e bitswe Setsi sa Tshebedisano ya Ntshetsopele ya Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa Nkwama wa Mpfuxeto wa Afrika na Ntirhisano wa Matiko ya Misava (ARF) Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa nkandziyiso wa Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa mpfapfarhuto wa ARF leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: ARF e tlilo phahamisa makgabane a Afrika Borwa le Tsoseletso ya Afrika ka sepheo sa ho theha lefatshe le molemo ho bohle.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta tlhela yi vula leswaku ARF sweswi yi ta vitani Ejensi ya Swinakulobye bya Nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: ARF e boetse e bohlokwa bakeng sa Afrika Borwa jwalo ka ha e ntlafatsa tshebedisano mmoho ya naha ya habo rona le tse ding, haholo tsa mona Afrika ka ho ntshetsapele demokrasi, puso e nepahetseng, thibelo le tharollo ya diqabang esitana le ntshetsopele ya moruo le tsa bodulo ha mmoho le dithuso tsa setjhaba le ntshetsopele ya ntlafatso ya disebediswa tsa thuso ya batho.
tgt: Ejensi leyi yi ta tirha tanihi xitirho ku lawula, ku seketela na ku humelerisa ntirhisano na mpfuneto wa nhluvukiso lowu fikaka emakumu wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Tlaleho ka ho Kgethwa hape ha Afrika Borwa ho ba Setho sa Moifo wa Matjhaba wa Bofofisi Kabinete e thabetse ho kgethwa hape ha Afrika Borwa ho ba Setho sa Moifo wa Matjhaba wa Bofofisi Diketsahalo tse Tlang1 Kgwedi ya Mandela Afrika Borwa le lefatshe lohle, di tla keteka Kgwedi ya Mandela kgweding ya Phupu tlasa lepetjo le reng “Maemo a Lehodimo, Dijo le Kopano.” Mona ho tla be ho hopolwa bophelo ba Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela ha mmoho le seo a se entseng ka ho nka mehato ho thusa ho tlisa diphetoho setjhabeng ka mekgwa e fapaneng ho kenyeletsa le ho lwantsha bofuma le ho selekalekane.
tgt: ARF i ya nkoka swonghasi eka ku kondletela mitsakelo ya rixaka na mikhuvanene swa Afrika-Dzonga, Mpfuxeto wa Afrika na ku tumbuluxiwa ka misava yo antswa ya hinkwavo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho Maafrika Borwa ohle ho sebedisetsa kgwedi ena ho etsa dintho tse tla tlisa phapang setjhabeng le ho aha Afrika Borwa eo Mandela a neng a e labalabela.
tgt: ARF yi tlhela yi va na nkoka eka Afrika-Dzonga tanihileswi yi antswisaka ntirhisano exikarhi ka tiko ra ka hina na matiko man'wana, ngopfungopfu matiko ma le Afrika, hikwalaho ka nkondletelo wa xidemokirasi, mafumelo lamanene, nsivelo na xitshunxo xa ntlimbo, nhluvukiso na mpfanganiso wa vanhu na ikhonomi mpfuneto wa vanhu na nhluvukiso wa swipfuno swa ximunhu.

src: 2 Seboka sa Tumellano e Ntjha ya Matjhaba ya Tshehetso ya Ditjhelete Ka la 22 le 23 Phuptjane Mopresidente Ramaphosa o tla nka karolo sebokeng sa tumellano e ntjha ya tshehetso ya ditjhelete mane Fora.
tgt: Ku nyika vuxokoxoko byintshwa hi mayelana na ku Hlawuriwa hi Vuntshwa ka Afrika-Dzonga ku tirha tanihi Xirho xa Khansele ya Nhlangano wa Vuhahisi bya Vaaki wa Matiko ya Misava Khabinete yi lemuke ku hlawuriwa hi vuntshwa ka Afrika-Dzonga ku tirha tanihi Xirho xa Khansele ya Nhlangano wa Vuhahisi bya Vaaki wa Matiko ya Misava Swiendleko leswi Taka1 N'hweti ya Mandela.1 Afrika-Dzonga na misava hinkwayo, hi Mawuwana, va ta tsundzuka N'hweti ya Mandela ehansi ka nkongomelo wa “Maxelo, Swakudya na Nkhomano”.

src: Afrika Borwa e tla sekaseka dintlha tse ngata tsa bohlokwa tse kenyeletsang diphetoho thehong ya mekgatlo e fapafapaneng ya tshehetso ya ditjhelete, mathata a dikoloto, mekgwa ya tshehetso ya ditjhelete, lekgetho la matjhaba ha mmoho le ditokelo tse ikgethang tsa ho ikgula tumellanong.
tgt: Hi n'hweti leyi, vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga va tlangela vutomi bya khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela, ndzhaka ya yena naswona va teka goza ku pfuna ku cinca vaakandhawu va ka hina leswaku va antswa, va pfanganisa matshalatshala ku hoxa xandla eka ku lwisana na vusweti na nkandzingano.2 Khabinete yi hlohlotela vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku tirhisa n'hweti leyi ku endla swin'wana leswi swi nga ta endla ku hambana emigangeni ya ka vona na ku tiyisisa leswaku hi aka Afrika-Dzonga leyi voniweke hi tatana wa hina wo simeka.

src: 3 Seboka sa Moifo wa Kemedi ya Baithuti Seboka sa RCL se tla tshwarelwa Yunivesithing ya Tshwane ka la 29 ho ya ho la 30 Phuptjane 2023 ka sepheo sa ho theha le ho matlafatsa karolo ya RCL dikolong.
tgt: 2 Samiti ya Ntwanano wo Nyika Timali wa Misava Hinkwayo wuntshwa.1 Phuresidente Ramaphosa hi siku ra 22 na 23 Khotavuxika 2023, u ta teka xiave eka samiti ya ntwanano a ku nyika timali wa misava hinkwayo eFurwa.

src: Seboka sa selemo sena se tla shebana le ho tshehetsa baithuti ka ho hlwaya ditlhoko tsa baithuti le ho ntlafatsa mosebetsi wa di-RCOna ke motjha wa bohlokwa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya baithuti naheng ena.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi ta tirhana na timhakakulu to tanihi antswiso wa mihlangano ya timali ta nhluvukiso ya matikonyingi, xirilo xa swikweleti, ku nyika timali ka vutumbuluxi, swibalo swa matiko ya misava ma timfanelo to tihumesa to hlawuleka.3 Khomferense ya Khansele ya Vuyimeri ya Vadyondzi (RCL)3.1 Khomferense ya RCL yi ta rhambiwa hi siku ra 29 na 30 Khotavuxika 2023 eYunivhesiti ya Pitori hi xikongomelo xa ku aka na ku tiyisa xiave xa tiRCL eswikolweni.2 Khomferense ya nan'waka yi ta kongomisa eka ku havexerisa vadyondzi, ku kumiwa ka swidingo swa vadyondzi na ku antswisa matirhelo ya tiRCLeyi i pulatifomo ya nkoka ya ku hluvukisa vurhangeri bya nkarhi lowu taka bya tiko leri.4 2023 Thonamente ya Khapi ya Misava ya Netibolo.1 Kha ri na 36 wa Masiku ku ya eka Khapi ya Misava ya Netibolo ya 2023 leyi yi nga ta va kona eCape Town International Convention Centre kusuka 28 Mawuwana kufika 6 Mhawuri 2023, Khabinete yi khense vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga hinkwavo eka ku amukela ka Vumunhu ka malwandla eka vanhu lava endzeke eka rendzo ra Thirofi ya Khapi ya Misava etikweni hinkwaro.

src: 4 Mohope wa Lefatshe wa 2023 wa Netball Jwalo ka ha ho se ho setse matsatsi a 36 feela pele Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Netball wa 2023 o qala mane Cape Town International Convention Centre ho tloha ka la 28 Phupu ho isa ka la 6 Phato 2023, Kabinete e leboha Maafrika Borwa ohle ka kamohelo ya ona e mofutho nakong ya dipontsho tsa Mohope ona ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Rendzo lera thirofi ri vumba xiphemu xa migingiriko yo yisa eka ntlangu wo pfula.

src: Leeto la dipontsho tsa mohope ke karolo ya boitokisetso ba ho qala ha dipapadi tsena.
tgt: Rendzo lera thirofi ri sungule eKwaZulu-Natal naswona ri ta nghena hi le Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Limpopo, N'walungu-Vupeladyambu, Free State, Kapa-N'walungu na Kapa Vupeladyambu.

src: Leeto lena le qadile mane KwaZulu-Natal mme le tla leba Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Limpopo, Leboya Bophirima, Foreisitata, Kapa Leboya le Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Rendzo leri ri ta gimeta eKapa-Vupeladyambu tanihi xifundza lexi rhurhelaka, ku nga si sungula thonamente leyi hi siku ra 28 Mawuwana 2023.5 Banyana Banyana va suka ku ya eka Khapi ya Misava ya FIFA ya Vavasati.1 Hi ku yimela rixaka, Khabinete yi navelele leswinene eka xipano xa bolo ya milenge ya vavasati ya rixaka, Banyana Banyana, tanihiloko xi ri eku lulamiseleni ku suka hi Ravuntlhanu 23 Khotavuxika 2023, kuya eka Khapi ya Misava ya FIFA ya Vavasati leyi yi nga ta khomeriwa eAustralia na le New Zealand hi Mawuwana.2 Matirhelo ya xipano eka tithonamente to hambanahambana ma tisile nkongomiso wa miehleketo wa misava hinkwayo eka nhluvukiso wa ntlangu wa vavasati eAfrika-Dzonga, tanihi xiphemu xa vutihavexerisi byo angarhela havexeriso wa rixaka wa vavasati etikweni.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Mahungu.

src: DitebohoKabinete e lebohisa le hona ho lebisa ditakaletso tse ntle ho: Bomampodi ba Afrika Borwa dipapading tsa tenese tsa ba tsamayang ka ditulo tse nang le mabidi e leng Donald Ramphadi le Kgothatso Montjane bao e bileng bompodi ba Grand Slam dikarolong tse fapafapaneng thonamenteng ya Garros mane Fora.
tgt: VuhoyozeriKhabinete yi hundzise vuhoyozeri bya yona na ku navelela leswinene eka: Vatlangi va thenisi va tiwhilichere va le Afrika-Dzonga Donald Ramphadi na Kgothatso Montjane lava va humeleleke tanihi tinghwazi ta Grand Slam eka swiavo swo vona hi ku hambana eka thonamente ya Roland Garros yo xiximeka eFurwa.

src: Boramabelo bohle ba nkileng karolo Lebelong la Comrade le neng le tloha Pietermaritzburg ho ya Thekong.
tgt: Vahluri hinkwavo va Matsambu ya Comrade ya 2023 na switsutsumi leswi swi teke xiave eka matsambukulu yo rhelela kusuka ePietermaritzburg kufika Durban.

src: Re lebohisa haholoholo Tete Dijana le Gerda Steyn, e seng feela ka ho hapa lebelo la banna le la basadi ka tatelano, empa le ka ho roba rekoto ya mabelo ana ka bobedi.
tgt: Hi hoyozela Tete Dijana na Gerda Steyn kungari eka ku hlula ntsena misayano ya vavanuna na ya vavasati hi ku hambana ka vona, kambe na ku tlhela va tshova tirhekodo to rhelela eka havumbirhi bya misiyano ya vavanuna na ya vavasati.

src: Ka ho qoholleha re rata ho lebohisa Ntate Johannes Mosehla wa Limpopo ya dilemo di 81 eo e bileng yena motho e moholo ka ho fetisisa ya kgonneng ho qeta lebelo la Comrade.
tgt: Ku vuriwa ko hlawuleka ku tlhela ku hlayiseriwa mutshami wa le Limpopo Tatana Johannes Mosehla loyi, eka malembe ya 81 hi vukhale, a veke munhu wa khale kutlula hinkwavo ku heta Comrades.

src: Kgweding ena ya Batjha, Maafrika Borwa a dilemo tse fapafapaneng a tlameha ho ithuta ho motho enwa e moholo makgabane le melemo ya ho ipoloka o phetse hantle.
tgt: Hi N'hweti ya Vantshwa, vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga va malembe hinkwawo hi vukhale va nga dyondza nkoka na ku vuyeriwa hi hanyelo leri nga na rihanyo kusuka eka mudyuhari lonkulu swonghasi.

src: Kabinete e boetse e thoholetsa Nomhle Ngwenya ka ho ba mosadi wa pele e motsho ya monyane dilemong wa ho ba le mangolo a thuto ya PhD ho saense Yunivesithing ya Wits a le dilemo di 25 feela.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela Nomhle Ngwenya ku va a ri wansati wa wantima lotsongo eka hinkwavo ku va wo sungula ku kuma PhD ku suka eka fakhalithi ya sayense ya Wits a ri na 25 wa malembe ntsena hi vukhale.

src: Mme P Khoza o kgethetswe ho ba Mopresidente wa Kopano ya bo 42 ya ICAO e neng e tshwerwe ka la 27 Loetse ho isa ka la 7 Mphalane 2022 mane Montreal, Khanada.
tgt: Mhn P Khoza loyi a hlawuriweke tanihi Phuresidente wa Huvo ya ICAO ya 42 leyi yi veke kona kusuka 27 Ndzati ku fika 7 Nhlangula eMontreal, Canada Michavelelo Khabinete yi hundzise michavelelo ya yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va: Xirho xa Palamende, Mhn Tina Joemat-Pettersson, loyi a ri Mutshamaxitulu wa Komiti ya Photifoliyo ya Huvo ya Rixaka hi mayelana na Maphorisa, naswona loyi eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza a tirha tanihi Holobye wa Vurimi, Swihlahla, na Tinhlampfi na Holobye wa Eneji.

src: Pele ho moo e kile ya eba Letona la Thuto Profinseng ya Kapa Leboya.
tgt: U tlhele a tirha tanihi MEC wa Dyondzo eKapa-N'walungu.

src: E ne e boetse e le setho sa Komiti ya Naha ya African National Congress (ANC) le sa Lekala la yona la Mafumahadi.
tgt: U tlhele a va xirho xa Komiti ya Vurhangerinkulu ya Rixaka ya African National Congress (ANC) na Ligi ya Vavasati ya ANMugingirikeli wo lwela ntshunxeko wa United Democratic Front.

src: E ne e boetse e le molwanedi wa tokoloho le setho sa United Democratic Front.
tgt: Hosi Kgagudi Kenneth Sekhukhune, Hosi ya Marota Mohlaletse, Hlabirw’a a Bauba tlhelo ka hosi yo khomela ya Mfumo wa Vapedi.

src: Kgoshi Kgagudi Kenneth Sekhukhune, Kgoshi ya Marota Mohlaletse, Hlabirw’a a Bauba le moemedi wa mehleng wa nako e telele wa Boreneng ba Bapedi.
tgt: Miehleketo na swikhongelo swa Khabinete swi na Ndyangu wa le Vukosini na Vapedi tanihiloko malulamiselo yo hetelela ma nkosi wa Hosi yo Khomela leyi nga lova ma le ku endliweni.

src: Kabinete e beha Lelapa la Boreneng dithapelong tsa yona jwalo ka ha le etsa ditlhophiso tsa ho boloka Mmusi enwa.
tgt: Khale ka mudzaberi wa ndhuma wa Bafana Bafana, Clive Barker, loyi a rhangeleke rixaka ra ka hina ku ya hlula eka Khapi ya Tinxaka ya Afrika ya 1996 leyi nga ya nkoka eka matimu, leyi a yi khomeriwile laha etikweni rosungula.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ntlha ya tswelopele ya Eskom ya Keketseho ya Motlakase, e hajwale e leng haufi le diperesente tse Ho ekeditswe ka dimekawate (MW) tse ka bang 400 pokellong ya motlakase mme tlhokomelo e rerilweng e ntlafetse haholo ka mora nako e fokolang.
tgt: IMiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni Ezamandla IKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubela yoMba wokuFumaneka koMbane kwa-Eskom, ngoku isondele kuma-70%.

src: Kabinete e boetse e lemohile qeto ya Ofisiri ya Boleng ba Moya ya Lefapha la Meru, Ditlhapi le Tikoloho ya ho tjhetjhisa nako ya pallo ya Eskom ya ho fihlella bonyane ba dipehelo tsa Tlhweko ya Moya Setsing sa Phehlo ya Motlakase sa Kusile se Mpumalanga, ho itshetlehile ka maemo a itseng a batsi.
tgt: Malunga neemegawathi ezingama-400 (i-MW) zongezwe kuthungelwano lombane kwaye ugcino olucwangcisiweyo luye lwaphucuka ngethutyana elifutshane.

src: Ho tjhetjhiswa hona ho tla thusa Eskom hore e lokise metjhini e ileng ya robeha ka la 23 Mphalane 2022.
tgt: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi yaqaphela ukuba isigqibo seGosa leSizwe elijonge ukuCoceka koMoya leSebe lezaMahlathi, ezokuLoba kunye nokusiNgqongileyo sokunika u-Eskom elinye ithuba lokuhlangabezana neMithetho yokuKhutshelwa kweGesi eMoyeni kwiSikhululo soMbane iKusile eMpumalanga, ngokulawulwa yimiqathango engqongqo ethile.

src: Setsha sena sa motlakase se tla boela se aha metjhini e meraro ya nakwana e lebelletsweng ho kgutlisetsa dimekawate tse 2 100 tsa motlakase boemong ba naha le ho fokotsa timatima ka mekgahlelo e mmedi.
tgt: Oku kuhlehliswa kuza kuvumela u-Eskom ukuba aqhube nokulungisa isakhelo esonakele ngomhla wama-23 kweyeDwarha 2022.

src: Kabinete e phaelletse ka hore mmuso o sebetsa ka thata ho Just Energy Transition (JET) mme o tsitlalletse ho bebofatsa kgahlamelo ya phetoho ya maemo a lehodimo.
tgt: Iziko lombane liza kwakha kwakhona izakhelo zexeshana ezintathu ekulindeleke ukuba zibuyisele i-2 100 MW yombane kuthungelwano lombane lwesizwe kunye nokunciphisa ukucinywa kombane ngamanqanaba amabini.

src: Kabinete e lebohile Maaforika Borwa a tswellang ho sebedisa motlakase ka nepo, haholoholo ka nako e tshebediso ya ona e leng hodimo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yagxininisa ukuba urhulumente uzibophelele kwiNguqu yezaMandla (i-JET) kwaye uzimisele ukuthomalalisa ifuthe lokutshintsha kwemozulu.

src: Boikgathatso ba rona ka kakaretso ba motlakase bo thusitse ho fokotsa mekgahlelo ya timatima.
tgt: I-JET, eyasekwa ngonyaka wama-2020, ijolise ekuphumezeni ukukhutshwa kwekhabhoni "ye-Net Zero" ngonyaka wama-2050.

src: Kabinete e ile ya boela ya ananela boitlamo bo entsweng Sebokeng sa Selekane se Setjha sa Ditjhelete tsa Lefatshe se neng se tshwaretswe Paris, naheng ya Fora ho tloha ka la 22 ho isa ho la 23 Phuptjane 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela abemi boMzantsi Afrika abaqhubekayo nokusebenzisa umbane ngononophelo, ngakumbi ngamaxesha aphezulu.

src: Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o ne a ile sebokeng seo, se neng se reretswe ho theha selekane dipakeng tsa dinaha tsa Leboya le tsa Borwa bakeng sa ho sekaseka mathata a phetoho ya maemo a lehodimo, ntshetsopele le mekitlana.
tgt: Iinzame zethu zamandla ezidityanisiweyo ziye zanceda ukuzisa amanqanaba asezantsi okucinywa kombane.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse kananelo ya yona ho dihlopha tsa Botsamaisi ba Porofense ba Dikoduwa ka thuso e potlakileng ha ba ne ba thusa setjhaba se anngweng ke dikgohola tse sa tswa feta KwaZulu-Natal le Kapa Leboya.
tgt: UMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa wayizimasa lo ngqungquthela, eyayijolise ekwakheni ikontraki entsha phakathi koMntla kunye noMzantsi ukunceda ukushukuxa imiba yokutshintsha kwemozulu, uphuhliso kunye netyala.

src: Kaofela re utlwisitswe bohloko ke ho kgaoha ha ditshiu KwaZulu-Natal, mme re fetisetsa matshediso a rona ho maloko le metswalle ya ba lahlehetsweng ke bophelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise umbulelo kumaqela oLawulo lweNtlekele kwiPhondo ngokukhawulezisa ekuncedeni uluntu oluchatshazelwe zizikhukula kutsha nje KwaZulu-Natala naseMntla Koloni.

src: Ditsela, phepelo ya motlakase, tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere le matlo a dibakeng tse amehileng KwaZulu-Natal di senyehile haholo mme ditsela tsa dikarolo tse itseng tsa Kapa Leboya di senyehile hampe.
tgt: Sonke sibuhlungu ngokusweleka kwabantu KwaZulu-Natala, kwaye sivakalisa uvelwano kwiintsapho nezihlobo zabo bathe baphulukana nobomi babo.

src: Mmuso le mekgatlo ya diphallelo di tswela ka ho nehelana ka thepa e thusang setjhaba se amehileng sa KwaZulu-Natal, mme yona e akga ka hare diphuthelwana tsa dijo,dikobo, dipolasetiki tse kgolo le mabokose a tshohanyetso.
tgt: Iziseko ezingundoqo zeendlela, unikezelo lombane, iinkqubo zogutyulo lwelindle kunye nezindlu kwiindawo ezichaphazelekayo KwaZulu-Natala zonakaliswe kakhulu ngelixa iindlela kwezinye iindawo zoMntla Koloni ziye zonakala.

src: Eskom le mafapha a dimasepala a motlakase le bona ba kene tshebetsong ya ho kgutlisetsa motlakase dibakeng tse amehileng.
tgt: Urhulumente kunye nemibutho yoncedo iyaqhubeka nokubonelela ngoncedo olukhawulezileyo kuluntu oluchaphazelekileyo KwaZulu-Natala, kuquka iipasile zokutya, iingubo zokulala, iingubo zeplasitiki kunye neebhokisi zikaxakeka.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Ketelo e atlehileng ya Tshebetso Mmoho ya Tonakgolo ya Netherlands, Monghadi Mark Rutte le Tonakgolo ya Denmark, Mofumahadi Mette Frederiksen e tiisitseng dikamano tsa Aforika Borwa le dinaha tsena tse pedi makaleng a haedrojene e tala, a tlhahiso ya matla a ntjhafatswang le a JEKetelo ena e boetse ya tlisa sehlopha sa batsetedi Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ho tiisa tshebetso mmoho le dikamano tse ntle mahareng a naha le balekane ba yona ba bohlokwa ba babedi ba Yuropa.
tgt: Utyelelo lokuSebenza ebeliQhutywe ngokuBambisana yi-Netherlands ne-Denmark IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uTyelelo lokuSebenza ngokuManyeneyo olube yimpumelelo phakathi kweNkulumbuso yase-Netherlands, uMnu Mark Rutte kunye neNkulumbuso yase-Denmark, uNks Mette Frederiksen oluqinise ubudlelwane boMzantsi Afrika nala mazwe mabini kwimiba yehaydrojini engenabungozi kokusingqongileyo, amandla ahlaziyekayo kunye ne-JEUtyelelo kwakhona lwazisa iqela labatyali-mali eMzantsi Afrika ukuqinisa amanqanaba aphezulu entsebenziswano kunye nobudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwelizwe kunye namaqabane amabini abalulekileyo aseYurophu.

src: Nakong ya semmuso ya dipuisano, Aforika Borwa le Netherlands di ile tsa tekena Memorandamo wa Kutlwisiso Lekaleng la Haedrojene e Tala, mme Aforika Borwa le Denmark tsona tsa ntjhafatsa tumellano e mabapi le Ntshetsopele ya Tshebedisano Mmoho e amanang le Lenaneo la Bolekane la Eneji la Pitso ya Moporesidente ya Mohlala wa Ntshetsopele ya Setereke sa KwaZulu-Natal (DDM) Moporesidente Ramaphosa, mmoho le baetapele ba mekgahlelo yohle e meraro ya mmuso (naha, porofense le lehae), ba ile ba tshwara DDM ya bosupa ya Pitso ya Moporesidente ya Tsamaiso ya Botshelela ka Labohlano la 30 Phuptjane 2023 Seterekeng sa Masepala wa Thukela, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Ngexesha leengxoxo ezisemthethweni ezidibeneyo, isiVumelwano sokuSebenzisana kuMmandla weHaydrojini Engenabungozi kokusiNgqongileyo satyikitywa phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Netherlands, ngelixa isivumelwano phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Denmark malunga neNtsebenziswano yoPhuhliso enxulumene neNkqubo yeNtsebenziswano yezaMandla yonyaka wama-2017 salungiswa.

src: Baetapele ba mmuso ba ile ba sebedisa monyetla ona bakeng sa ho buisana le baahi ka mathata a phano ya ditshebeletso le maano a ntshetsopele ya setereke.
tgt: Imbizo kaMongameli yeNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweZithili yaKwaZulu-Natala (i-DDM) UMongameli Ramaphosa, edibene neenkokheli eziphuma kuwo omathathu amanqanaba oburhulumente (kuzwelonke, kwiphondo nakwingingqi), bathabathe iMbizo kaMongameli yesiXhenxe ye-DDM yoLawulo lweSithandathu ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-30 kweyeSilimela 2023 kuMasipala weSithili uThukela KwaZulu-Natala.

src: Kabinete e ipileditse ho baahi ho bapala karolo e hlwahlwa ya ho lokisa bokamoso ba setjhaba ka ho nka karolo lenaneong la DDM ya Pitso ya Moporesidente.3 Baahi bohle ba naha ba kgothalletswa ho bapala karolo ya bona ntshetsong pele ya setjhaba ka ho ba baahi ba hlwahlwa.
tgt: Iinkokheli zikarhulumente zisebenzise eli thuba ukunxibelelana nabahlali ngemingeni yonikezelo lweenkonzo kunye nezicwangciso zophuhliso lwesithili.

src: Ha re sebetsa mmoho, re ka hlwaya dintlha tse re tshwenyang mme ra tlosa ditshita tsa tshebetso mmoho ho phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icele abahlali ukuba badlale indima ebonakalayo ekumiseleni ikamva loluntu lwabo ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo ye-DDM yeeMbizo zikaMongameli.

src: Le ha e le mona kgolo e sa le tlase, moruo wa rona o sa itlohelleng o tswela pele ho theha mesebetsi, le ha e se ka sekgahla se re se batlang.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisana, sinokubona imiba exhalabisayo kwaye sivule imiqobo ekunikezelweni kweenkonzo okuhlangeneyo.

src: Dithuso tse jwalo ka lenaneo la Tshusumetso ya Mosebetsi la Moporesidente di thusa ho fetola maemo.
tgt: Uqoqosho IKhabhinethi icinge ngeeNkcukacha-manani zeKota zamva nje ezikhutshwe liZiko leeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika (i-Stats SA) ezibonise ukuhla kwengqesho kumacandelo ahlukeneyo kunye neenzuzo kwamanye.

src: Kabinete e kgothaditswe ke hore ka Tlhakubele 2023, batho ba fetang miliyone fielwane pedi ba ne ba se ba unne molemo lenaneong lena ho tloha ha le ne le qala ka selemo sa 2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthazekile ukuba kwinyanga yoKwindla 2023, bangaphezu kwesigidi esi-1.2 abantu abathe baxhamla ngokuthe ngqo kule nkqubo ukususela oko yathi yasekwa ngonyaka wama-2020.

src: Ho fihlela hajwale, ho se ho thehilwe mesebetsi e ka bang 800 000 ya nakwana bakeng sa batjha, makaleng a kang la thuto, dikolo tsa dikonyana le la polokeho ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, malunga nama-800 000 emisebenzi yexeshana elifutshane, ingakumbi elungiselelwe ulutsha, edalwe kwimimandla ebalulekileyo, kwezemfundo, uphuhliso lwabantwana abaselula nokhuseleko loluntu.

src: Lenaneo lena le entse bonnete ba hore Maaforika Borwa a mangata a hlokang thuso a sebetsa mme a fumana mokgolo ka dinako tsohle.
tgt: Le nkqubo iqinisekise ukuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika abaninzi abasesichengeni bathatha inxaxheba kumsebenzi onentsingiselo kwaye bafumana umvuzo ozinzileyo.

src: Le thusitse ho fokotsa mathata a moruo ho diketekete tsa malapa.
tgt: Iye yanceda ekuthomalaliseni ubunzima bezoqoqosho kumawakawaka eentsapho.

src: Kabinete hape e amohetse phatlalatso e kopanetsweng ya maikemisetso a ho theha Lebotho la Tshebetso la Aforika Borwa le Jeremane la Haedrojene, e ileng ya tekenelwa ke Letona la Boporesidente le ikarabellang ho Motlakase, Ngaka Kgosientsho Ramokgopa le Motlatsa Motjhanselara e leng Robert Habeck.
tgt: IHaydrojini Engenabungozi kokusiNgqongileyo IKhabhinethi iphinde yasamkela isibhengezo esihlangeneyo senjongo yokuseka uMbutho waBasebenzi beHaydrojini eMzantsi Afrika naseJamani, esatyikitywa nguMphathiswa okwi-Ofisi kaMongameli ojongene noMbane, uGq Kgosientsho Ramokgopa kunye noSekela-Tshansela waseJamani u-Robert Habeck.

src: Sehlopha sa tshebetso se tla lekola hore mmaraka wa haedrojene e tala o tla thehwa jwang le ho ntshetswapele, le ho theha menyetla ya kgwebisano dipakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi.
tgt: Umbutho wabasebenzi uza kujonga indlela imakhethi yehaydrojini engenabungozi kokusingqongileyo eya kwenziwa ngayo kwaye iphuhliswe, kunye nokudala amathuba oshishino ukuya kumashishini phakathi kwamazwe amabini.

src: Haedrojene e tala e hlahiswa ka matla a ntjhafatswang mme e na le mosi o tlase wa khabone ho feta haedrojene e tlwaelehileng.
tgt: Ihaydrojini engenabungozi kokusingqongileyo iveliswa ngamandla ahlaziyekayo kwaye inokukhutshwa kwekhabhoni esezantsi kakhulu kunehaydrojini yemveli.

src: Mmuso o se o thehile meralo bakeng sa Phula ya Haedrojene, e lebelletsweng ho tloha Limpopo, e fete Johannesburg, ho ya Durban.
tgt: Urhulumente sele equlunqe izicwangciso zenkqubo ye-Hydrogen Valley, ekulindeleke ukuba iqale eLimpopo, inqumle eRhawutini, iye kutsho eThekwini.

src: Phula ena e tla theha menyetla ya diporojeke tse tla qala tshebetso ya haedrojene ditsing ka morero wa ho nyolla moruo le ho theha mesebetsi.
tgt: Le nkqubo iza kuseka amathuba eeprojekthi eziya kuqalisa amaphulo ehaydrojini kwiindawo zokuhlala ngenjongo yokukhulisa uqoqosho nokudalwa kwemisebenzi.

src: Seboka sa Dihloho tsa Dinaha le Mmuso sa Mokgatlo wa Kopano ya Dinaha tse Borwa ba Aforika wa Lekgetho la tse Rekilweng Kantle ho Naha (SACU) Kabinete e lemohile Leeto la Tshebetso la Moporesidente Ramaphosa la Seboka sa bo robedi SACU e leng sa Dihloho tsa Dinaha le Mebuso se neng se tshwaretswe Boreneng ba Swatsing ka Labone la 29 Phupu 2023.
tgt: INgqungquthela yeeNtloko zeMibuso noRhulumente woMbutho woRhwebo e-Afrika eseMazantsi (i-SACU).

src: SACU, e thehilweng ka 1910, ke Mokgatlo wa Lekgetho la Dithoto tse Rekilweng ka Ntle ho Naha o moholo ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluqaphele uTyelelo loMsebenzi lukaMongameli u-Ramaphosa oluya kwiNgqungquthela yeSibhozo yeeNtloko zeMibuso nooRhulumente ye-SACU ebibanjelwe eBukhosini baseSwatini ngoLwesine, umhla wama-29 kweyeSilimela 2023.

src: Seboka se ile sa buisana le ho fana ka dintlha tse ntjha tsa maemo a ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Leano la Moralo wa SACU wa 2022 ho ya ho 2027.
tgt: I-SACU eyasekwa ngo-1910, yeyona Manyano yezoRhwebo endala ehlabathini.

src: Leano la Moralo la SACU le amohetswe ka Phuptjane 2022 jwalo ka mmapa wa ho tebisa kopano ya lebatowa Mokgatlong wa Lekgetho la tse Rekilweng ka Ntle ho Naha le ho theha maqhama a matla mahareng a dinaha tse hlano tseo e leng ditho le ho nka monyetla o tlisitsweng ke Lebatowa la kgwebisano Ntle le Ditefello la Kontinente ya Aforika.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yaxoxa yaza yanikezela ngohlaziyo ngobume bokuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga se-SACU sonyaka wama-2022 ukuya kowama-2027.

src: Kabinete e ngongorehiswa ke borafi bo seng molaong mme mmuso o nka mehato ya ho bo fedisa ka Sehlopha sa Naha sa Bohokahanyi le Boqhetseke ba Taolo (NCSMT).
tgt: IsiCwangciso-qhinga se-SACU samkelwa ngenyanga yeSilimela ngonyaka wama-2022 njengomgaqo wokwenza nzulu ukudityaniswa kommandla kuManyano yezoRhwebo kunye nokwakha ubudlelwane obuluqilima phakathi kwamazwe amahlanu angamalungu kwakunye nokusebenzisa amathuba aveliswe ngukuRhwebelana koMmandla we-Afrika okungaHlawulisi iRhafu.

src: NCSMT e batla ho hokahanya matsapa a mmuso bakeng sa ho thibela borafi bo seng molaong le ho hweba ka majwe ana a bohlokwa.
tgt: Ukwembiwa kwemigodi IKhabhinethi inenkxalabo ngomkhwa wokwembiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kwaye urhulumente uthatha amanyathelo okuwuphelisa esebenzisa i-National Coordination and Strategic Management Team (i-NCSMT).

src: Borafi bo seng molaong le ho hweba ka majwe a bohlokwa ho lematsa moruo wa rona, mme ho na le seabo se sebe polokehong le bophelong ba setjhaba se potapotileng.
tgt: I-NCSMT ijonge ukulungelelanisa iinzame zikarhulumente zokulwa nokwembiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nokurhweba ngezimbiwa zexabiso.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya pheta hore merusu ha se tharollo ya mathata a setjhaba mme ya ipiletsa ho setjhaba ho sebedisa metjha e teng bakeng sa ho hlahisa dingongoreho tsa bona.
tgt: Ukwembiwa kwesinyithi kunye nokurhweba ngokungekho mthethweni kuyalonakalisa uqoqosho lwethu, kwaye kunempembelelo embi kukhuseleko nempilo yoluntu.

src: Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Matona se romelletswe Diepsloot Gauteng ho ilo sebetsa le baetapele ba setjhaba bakeng sa ho lokisa dintlha tse ba tshwenyang.
tgt: Uqhankqalazo loluntu IKhabhinethi iphinde yathi ubundlobongela ayisosisombululo kwiingxaki zoluntu kwaye icela uluntu ukuba lusebenzise imijelo esele ikhona ukusombulula iingxaki zalo.

src: Kabinete e ipileditse ho setjhaba sa Diepsloot le dibaka tse ding ho sebetsa le mmuso, makhanselara a lehae le mapolesa bakeng sa ho rarolla mathata a kang botlokotsebe.
tgt: IGqiza laBaphathiswa eliSebenzayo lithe latyalwa e-Diepsloot e- Gauteng ukuze lisebenze neenkokheli zabahlali ukulungisa imiba ebaxhalabisayo.

src: Moralo wa Leano la Matsete a Naha (CIS) Kabinete e ananetse moralo wa Aforika Borwa wa CIS bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icele abahlali base-Diepsloot kunye nezinye iindawo ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente, ooceba basekuhlaleni kunye namapolisa ukusombulula imiba efana nolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: CIS, e phatlaladitsweng bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba ka 2022, e batla ho beha naha jwalo ka naha ya mantlha ya Aforika ya mmamoratwa ka matsete ka ho phahamisa boleng ba matsete a hlahang ka ntle ho naha le a ka hara naha.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi UYilo lwesiCwangciso soTyalo-mali seLizwe (i-CIS) IKhabhinethi iluvumile uyilo loMzantsi Afrika lwe-CIS ukuba luphunyezwe.

src: Leano lena le tsheheditswe ka matsete a ka sehloohong a naha le maikemisetso a ntshetsopele ya moruo jwalo ka ho eketsa mesebetsi, ho fokotsa bofuma, le ho tshehetsa phetoho e ntle ya moruo ho ya ho moruo wa khabone e tlase le tshireletseho ya eneji.
tgt: I-CIS, eyapapashwa ngonyaka wama-2022 ukuze uluntu luhlomle ngalo, ifuna ukubeka eli lizwe njengendawo ephambili ekhethwayo yotyalo-mali e-Afrika ngokunyusa umgangatho wotyalo-mali oluthe ngqo lwangaphandle nolwasekhaya.

src: E fana ka mekgwa ya matsete bakeng sa ho hohela dikgwebo tse nyane, tse mahareng le tse kgolo ho tsitlallela kgolo ya moruo, haholoholo moruo o motala.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sisekelwe kutyalo-mali oluphambili lwelizwe kunye neenjongo zophuhliso loqoqosho ezifana nokwanda kwengqesho, ukunciphisa intlupheko, kunye nokuxhasa utshintsho olunobulungisa kuqoqosho lwekhabhoni ephantsi kunye nokhuseleko lwamandla.

src: Leano lena le boetse le kenella ditumellanong tsa dinaha tse ngata, lebatowa le dinaha tse pedi tse tekennweng ke Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Sibonelela ngeendlela zotyalo-mali ukutsala amashishini amancinci, aphakathi kunye nasakhasayo kwiphulo lohlumo loqoqosho, ngakumbi ukutshintshela kuqoqosho olungenabungozi kokusingqongileyo.

src: Leano lena le bapisitswe le maikemisetso a Moralo wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha wa phetoho ya moruo le Leano la Naha la Moralo wa Motheo la 2020 le sa tswa kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso silungelelaniswe neenjongo zesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe malunga nenguqu kwezoqoqosho kunye nesiCwangciso seZiseko ezinguNdoqo seSizwe sonyaka wama-2050 esamkelwe kutshanje.

src: Diporofense tsa naha le bomasepala ba tsona ba metse e meholo di tla ba bohareng ba ho tsamaisa leano lena, le tla dula le ikamahanya le maemo a fetofetohang a moruo.
tgt: Amaphondo esizwe kunye noomasipala bawo abambaxa aza kuba sembindini ekuqhubeni esi sicwangciso, esiya kuthi rhoqo silungelelaniswe kwimeko yezoqoqosho eguqukayo.

src: Tlaleho ya Boraro ya Nako le Nako ya Naha ka Tlasa Tumellano ya Matjhaba Kgahlano le Tlhokofatso le Bokgopo le, ho Hloka Botho kapa Tshwaro e Theolang Seriti kapa Kutlwiso Bohloko (CAT).
tgt: Ingxelo yelizwe yesithathu phantsi kwesiVumelwano seZizwe ngezizwe esichasene neNtuthumbo kunye nezinye iiNkohlakalo kunye neMpatho engenabuntu okanye iSohlwayo (i-CAT).

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha tlaleho ya boraro ya nako le nako ya CAT ya Aforika Borwa ho Mongodikakaretso wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa kwengxelo yesithathu ye-CAT yoMzantsi Afrika kuNobhala-Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN).

src: Tlaleho e hlalosa mehato eo Aforika Borwa e e nkang bakeng sa ho thibela tlhokofatso le tshwaro e mpe ho baahi.
tgt: Ingxelo ichaza amanyathelo athathwa nguMzantsi Afrika ukuthintela ukungcungcuthekiswa kunye nokuphathwa kakubi kwabemi.

src: Aforika Borwa e tekenetse Tumellano ena ka selemo sa 2000 e be e tiiswa ka selemo sa 2008.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika utyikitye isiVumelwano ngonyaka wama-2000 waza ngonyaka wama-2008 wasiqinisekisa.

src: Ho latela Article 17 ya Optional Protocol ho CAT, enngwe ya ditlamo tse filweng Mekga ya Naha ke ho theha mekgwa ya lehae ya ho thibela tlhokofatso e tsejwang ka Mekgwa ya Naha ya Thibelo.
tgt: Ngokuhambelana neNqaku le-17 loMthetho wokuZiphatha ongaNyanzelisiyo (i-Optional Protocol) kwi-CAT, enye yezibophelelo ezinyanzeliswe kumaQela kaRhulumente kukuseka iindlela zasekhaya zokuthintela intuthumbo eyaziwa ngokuba yiNkqubo yoThintelo yeSizwe.

src: Dilemong tse 10 tse fetileng, mmuso wa demokerasi wa Aforika Borwa o tlositse melao le ditheo tsa puso ya kgethollo, wa aha ditheo tse ntjha tsa demokerasi, mme wa qala melao e itshetlehileng ho ditokelo le ditokoloho tsa molaotheo.
tgt: Kule minyaka ingama-29 idlulileyo, urhulumente wentando yesininzi eMzantsi Afrika uye wayisusa imithetho namaziko amadala ocalu-calulo, wakha amaziko amatsha entando yesininzi, waza wasungula imithetho esekelwe kumalungelo omgaqo-siseko kunye nenkululeko.

src: Ditho tsa setjhaba di kgona ho tlaleha diqoso tsa tlhokofatso le tshwaro e mpe ho Bolaodi bo Ikemetseng ba Diphuputso tsa Sepolesa ka kotloloho bakeng sa diphuphutso.
tgt: Uluntu luyakwazi ukuxela izityholo zokungcungcuthekiswa kunye nempatho-mbi kwiCandelo loPhando lwaMapolisa eliZimeleyo ukuze ziphandwe.

src: Aforika Borwa e boetse e na le Khomishene ya Ditokelo tsa Botho e sebetsang hantle, e leng setheo sa naha se thehetsweng ho tshehetsa molaotheo wa demokerasi.
tgt: Kwakhona uMzantsi Afrika ukwaneKomishoni yamaLungelo oLuntu esebenza kakuhle, iziko lesizwe elimiselwe ukuxhasa intando yesininzi yomgaqo-siseko.

src: Khiro Khiro tsohle di itshetlehile ho netefatso ya mangolo a thuto le tumello e maleba.
tgt: Izikhundla Zonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Mofumahadi Ntomboxolo Mbengashe jwalo ka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Post Bank ya Aforika Borwa bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: UNks Ntomboxolo Mbengashe njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba (i-CEO) yeBhanki yePosi yoMzantsi Afrika ixesha leminyaka emihlanu.

src: Monghadi Sibusiso Bukhosini jwalo ka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso wa Isimangaliso Wetland Park Authority (O kgethwa hape).
tgt: UMnu Sibusiso Bukhosini njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba ye-Isimangaliso Wetland Park Authority (uqeshiwe kwakhona).UNks Tamlyn Bouwer njengeGosa eliPhethe i-Ofisi yeMali yeBhunga leSizwe lokuBhalisa abaKhi bezindlu.

src: Mofumahadi Tamlyn Bouwer jwalo ka Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete wa Lekgotla la Naha la Ngodiso ya Baahi ba Matlo.
tgt: UMnu Morongwa Calvin Molongoana njengoSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele (u-DDG): kwicandelo le-Statistics Support and Informatics kwiZiko leeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Monghadi Morongwa Calvin Molongoana jwalo ka Motlatsa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso (DDG): Tshehetso ya Dipalopalo le Tlhahisoleseding ho Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UNks Daphne Yandiswa Morudu njengo-DDG: INkqubo yeeNkcukacha-manani yeSizwe yaseMzantsi Afrika kwiZiko leeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika UMnu Rory Gallocher njengeGosa eliPhezulu leMisebenzi kuBongameli.

src: Dibili.
tgt: D IMithetho eYilwayo.

src: Moralo wa Ditokiso tsa Bili ya Dikhamphane wa 2023 Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dikhamphane sa 2023 Palamenteng hore e sebetsane le sona.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo wonyaka wama-2023 weeNkampani IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkampani wonyaka wama-2023 ukuze uqwalaselwe.

src: Ditshisinyo tse Biling ena di reretswe ho fokotsa boima ba taolo le tsamaiso ho beng ba dikgwebo mme e tla matlafatsa kgohedi ya Aforika Borwa ho batsetedi ba kamoso.
tgt: Izindululo ezikulo Mthetho uYilwayo zijolise ekunciphiseni umthwalo wommiselo nowolawulo kubanini bamashishini kwaye ziza kukhulisa umtsalane woMzantsi Afrika kwabo banokuba ngabatyali-zimali.

src: Bongata ba dihlomathiso e ne e le tse tshophodi, mme di ne di ikamahantse le ho nolofatsa le ho hlakisa ditaba tsa tsamaiso.
tgt: Uninzi lwezihlomelo bezinobugcisa ngokwendalo, kwaye bezijongene nohlenga-hlengiso kunye nokucacisa imiba yolawulo.

src: Enngwe ya dintlha tse ka sehloohong ya mmuso ona wa demokerasi ke ho thehwa ha mesebetsi mme ho ke ke ha fihlellwa ha fela ho sa lokiswe bobebe boo kgwebo e etswang ka bona Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Enye yezinto ezingundoqo eziphambili kulo rhulumente wentando yesininzi kukudala imisebenzi kwaye oku akunakufezekiswa ukuba ukukhululeka kokwenza ushishino eMzantsi Afrika akushukuxwa.

src: Dihlomathiso di boetse di fana ka tlhakiso e toma ya dikarolo tse mmalwa tsa Bili, tse batlang ho fokotsa taolo ya dikgwebo ho kwala dikgeo tsa tshebediso e mpe ya ditjhelete ho tiisa ditlhoko tsa phatlalatso le ho ntshetsapele matla a ba nang le diabo khamphaneng.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo zikwanika ingcaciso ethe kratya kwinani lamagatya akulo Mthetho uYilwayo, zifuna ukunciphisa inkqubo yommiselo kumashishini ziqinisa izikhewu ezichasene nokuthutyeleziswa kwemali ukomeleza iimfuno zokubhengeza kunye nokwandisa amagunya abanini-zabelo kwinkampani.

src: Moputso o fetang tekanyo, haholoholo maemong a hodimo a khamphane, ke tlhoba boroko matjhabeng le Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umvuzo ogqithisileyo, ngakumbi kumanqanaba aphezulu enkampani, ngumcimbi oxhalabisa kakhulu kumazwe ngamazwe kunye nalapha eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Dihlomathiso tse Biling di tla kgothaletsa ponaletso le ho hlakisa boikarabelo mahareng a batsamaisi le balaodi ba ka sehloohong ka lehlakoreng le leng, le ba nang le diabo ka ho le leng, mmoho le ho rarolla dingongoreho tsa setjhaba tse mabapi le ho se lekalekane ho teng setjhabeng.
tgt: zihlomelo ezikulo Mthetho uYilwayo ziza kukhuthaza ukwenziwa kwezinto elubala kwaye zicacise uxanduva phakathi kwabalawuli nabaphathi abaphezulu kwelinye icala, nabanini-zabelo kwelinye, kunye nokulungisa iinkxalabo zoluntu malunga namazinga aphezulu okungalingani eluntwini.

src: Bili ya Boitekolo ba Mmuso, Tshehetso le Bonamodi (IMSI) ya 2022 Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Bili ya IMSI ya 2022 bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo wonyaka wama-2022 wokuBeka esweni, iNkxaso kunye namaNgenelelo kuRhulumente (i-IMSI) IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koyilo loMthetho oYilwayo we-IMSI wonyaka wama-2022 ukuze uluntu luveze izimvo zalo.

src: Bili e tla sebediswa jwalo ka phumola keledi ya diphephetso tse ngata tse bileng teng ha mmuso o ne o tshehetsa karolo ya 100 le ya 139 tsa Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa wa 1996 ha o ne o tshwanela ho etsa seo ka lebaka la bofokodi ba makala a mang a mmuso.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kusetyenziswa njengesisombululo kwimingeni emininzi efunyenwe xa urhulumente ebesebenzisa icandelo le-100 nele-139 loMgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika yonyaka we-1996 xa kunyanzeleke ukuba enze njalo ngenxa yokusilela kwamanye amacandelo karhulumente.

src: Karolo ya 100 e fa mmuso matla a ho kena dipakeng ha porofense e hloleha ho phethahatsa boitlamo ba yona ba tsamaiso le ba phano ya ditshebeletso mme Karolo ya 139 yona e fa bolaodi ba porofense matla a ho namola ha eba masepala a sa phethise ditshwanelo ka holatela Molaotheo kapa ketsamolao.
tgt: ICandelo le-100 lixhobisa urhulumente ukuba angenelele ukuba iphondo liyasilela ukuhlangabezana nezibophelelo zalo zolawulo nonikezelo lweenkonzo ngelixa iCandelo le-139 lixhobisa isigqeba sephondo esinolawulo oluphezulu ukuba singenelele ukuba umasipala akalufezi uxanduva ngokoMgaqo-siseko okanye ngokomthetho.

src: Bili ya IMSI e tsebiswa jwalo ka sesebediswa sa taolo bakeng sa ho rarolla diphephetso tsa ho kenya Karolo ya 139 tshebetsong, tlhokomelo le tekolo, le tshusumetso ya bonamodi.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo we-IMSI waziswa njengesixhobo sokulawula ukujongana nemingeni ekunyanzeliseni iCandelo le-139, ukubeka iliso novavanyo, kunye nefuthe longenelelo.

src: Bili ena etla laola ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Karolo ya 139 ya Molaotheo, ho kenyeletsa le metjha e maleba.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uya kulawula ukuphunyezwa kweCandelo le-139 loMgaqo-siseko, kuquka neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo.

src: E tla fana ka tshehetso e lokelang ho bomasepala ba hlokang thuso, mmoho le ho fana ka tlhokomelo ya hore bomasepala ba phethisa boitlamo ba bona ba mantlha ka ho latela Molaotheo le ketsamolao.
tgt: Uza kubonelela ngenkxaso ekujoliswe kuyo koomasipala abafuna uncedo, kwaye ukwabonelela ngokubeka iliso koomasipala ukuze bafezekise izibophelelo zabo zolawulo ngokoMgaqo-siseko okanye ngokomthetho.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa bohle hore sehla sa 2023 sa ho tlaleha lekgetho se tla bulwa ka Labohlano la 7 Phupu 2023, mme se tla tswella ho fihla ka 23 Mphalane 2023.
tgt: Imisitho Ezayo Ixesha leRhafu IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza wonke umntu ukuba ixesha lokufakwa kwerhafu lonyaka wama-2023 liza kuvulwa ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wesi-7 kweyeKhala 2023 liqhube kude kube ngumhla wama-23 kweyeDwarha 2023.

src: Balefalekgetho ba kgothaletswa ho tlaleha lekgetho la bona ho eFilling kapa ho MobiApp ya Lefapha la Ditshebeletso tsa Lekgetho la Aforika Borwa (SARS).
tgt: Abahlawuli berhafu bayakhuthazwa ukuba bafake iingxelo zabo kwi-eFiling okanye kwi-MobiApp yeNkonzo yeRhafu yoMzantsi Afrika (u-SARS).

src: Motjha wa ho tlaleha lekgetho o se o le bobebe le ho feta mme SARS e tswela pele ka ditlhahlobo tsa auto-assessment selemong sena.
tgt: Inkqubo yokufakwa kwerhafu ngoku ilula ngakumbi kwaye u-SARS uza kuqhubeka novavanyo oluzenzekelayo kulo nyaka.

src: Ho tloha ka la 1 le la 7 Phupu 2023, balefalekgetho ba ile ba romellwa melaetsakgutshwe e le ha ba tsebiswa hore ba kgethilwe bakeng sa ditlhahlobo tsa auto-assessment.
tgt: Phakathi komhla woku-1 kunye nowe-7 kweyeKhala 2023, abahlawuli berhafu baza kwaziswa nge-SMS okan nge-imeyile ukuba bakhethelwe ukufumana uvavanyo oluzenzekelayo.

src: Ha o ka fumana molaetsakgutshwe, mohato wa hao o latelang e tla ba ho lekola ditlhahlobo tsa auto-assessment ho MobiApp wa SARS kapa ho eFilling.
tgt: Ukuba uthe wayifumana i-SMS, inyathelo elilandelayo lakho liya kuba kukuhlola uvavanyo oluzenzekelayo kwi-MobiApp yakwa-SARS okanye kwi-eFiling.

src: Ha eba o dumellana le ditlhahlobo tsa auto-assessment, ha ho letho le o tlamehang ho le etsa.
tgt: Ukuba novavanyo oluzenzekelayo, akukho mfuneko yokuba wenze nantoni na.

src: Ho kenya tlaleho ya hao ya lekgetho ka nako ho netefatsa hore balefalekgetho ba dula ba le maemong a matle, mme ho thusa mmuso ho fa Maaforika Borwa ditshebeletso le ho hodisa moruo.
tgt: Ukungeniswa kwangethuba nangokuchanekileyo kweengxelo zerhafu kuqinisekisa ukuba abahlawuli berhafu bahlala bethobela umthetho, kwaye kunceda urhulumente ukuba anikezele ngeenkonzo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika nokukhulisa uqoqosho.

src: Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Basadi wa FIFA 2023.
tgt: INdebe yeHlabathi yabaseTyhini ye-FIFA yowama-2023 IBanyana Banyana, iiNtshatsheli ze-Afrika ezilawulayo, kunye neqhayiya lesizwe, iza kuthwala amathemba namaphupha oMzantsi Afrika xa ithatha inxaxheba kwiNdebe yeHlabathi yabaseTyhini ye-FIFA yowama-2023 e-New Zealand nase-Australia ukusuka ngomhla wama-20 kweyeKhala ukuya kowama-20 kweyeThupha 2023.

src: Banyana Banyana, bompodi ba ntseng ba se dutse se maratswana sa Aforika, ebile setjhaba se ipela ka bona, ba tla jara tshepo le toro ya Aforika Borwa ha ba nka karolo Mohopeng wa Lefatshe wa Basadi wa FIFA 2023 ho la New Zealand le Australia ho tloha ka la 20 Phupu ho leba ho la 20 Phato 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibanqwenelela okuhle kodwa njengoko bekwiphulo lokufuna udumo.

src: Kabinete e ba lakaletsa mahlohonolo jwalo ka ha ba kena letsholong le babatsehang.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika unabo inyathelo ngalinye, kwaye sijonge phambili kubo ukuba benze imbali entsha kunye nokukhuthaza izizukulwana ezizayo.

src: Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Netbolo wa 2023.
tgt: INdebe yeHlabathi yeBhola yoMnyazi yowama-2023 Kwezi ntsuku zimbalwa zizayo, amehlo ehlabathi lezemidlalo aza kujonga eKapa, eMzantsi Afrika, xa kuqalwa iNdebe yeHlabathi yeBhola yoMnyazi yowama-2023 ukusuka ngomhla wama-28 kweyeKhala ukuya kowe-6 kweyeThupha.

src: Matsasing a mmalwa a tlang, barati ba dipapadi ba tla tsepamisa maikutlo Cape Town, hona mona Aforika Borwa ha Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Netbolo wa 2023 o qala ka la 28 Phupu ho leba ho 6 Phato.
tgt: Kukokokuqala ukuba lo mboniso ubalaseleyo kwihlabathi ubanjelwe e-Afrika.

src: Lena ke lekgetlo la pele tlhodisano ena e babatsehang ya lefatshe e tshwarelwa kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela wonke umntu kweli lizwe ukuba axhase amantombazana ethu njengoko ezama ukwenza imbali ngokuphumelela igolide e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ka hara naha ho tshehetsa banana ba rona jwalo ka ha ba ikemiseditse ho etsa nalane ka ho hapa kgauta kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Imiyalezo Amazwi okuvuyisana IKhabhinethi ithumela amazwi okuvuyisana kunye neminqweno emihle kwaba balandelayo:IYunivesithi yoMzantsi Afrika ngokufikelela kwinqanaba elibalulekileyo leminyaka eli-150 yokugqwesa kwimfundo ephakamileyo, nokuba lelona ziko likhulu nelona lidala kwi-Afrika ekuMazantsi ye-Sahara elizinikele kwimfundo esemgangathweni nakwihlabathi liphela.

src: DithoholetsoKabinete e lebisa dithoholetso le ditakaletso tsa mahlohonolo ho: Yunivesithi ya Aforika Borwa ka ho fihlella sehlohlolo sa dilemo tse 150 tsa boqhetseke ba thuto e phahameng, le ho ba setheo se seholo le sa kgale ka ho fetisisa sa Aforika e Borwa ba Sahara se sebetsang ka thata ho boleng ba thuto ya matjhaba.
tgt: UMnu Edward Kieswetter, uMkomishinala wakwa-SARS, emva kokuchongwa kwakhe njengosihlalo woMbutho woRhwebo weHlabathi kunye nokuba ngummi woMzantsi Afrika wesibini ukuba ngusihlalo walo mbutho.

src: Monghadi Edward Kieswetter, Mokomishenara wa SARS, ka ho kgethwa jwalo ka modulasetulo wa Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Lekgetho le ho ba Moaforika Borwa wa bobedi wa ho etella mokgatlo ona pele.
tgt: UMmeli Pansy Tlakula ekunyulweni kwakhona kwakhe kwiKomiti yeZizwe eziManyeneyo yokupheliswa kocalu-calulo ngokobuhlanga.

src: Issues in the Environment.
tgt: Issues in the Environment.

src: South African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) Western Cape taxi strike Cabinet was briefed about the ongoing impasse between SANTACO Western Cape and the City of Cape Town, which has escalated into a violent strike as a result of the impounding of taxi vehicles by the City of Cape Town.
tgt: South African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) Western Cape taxi strike Cabinet was briefed about the ongoing impasse between SANTACO Western Cape and the City of Cape Town, which has escalated into a violent strike as a result of the impounding of taxi vehicles by the City of Cape Town.

src: Cabinet condemns the violence and anarchy in Cape Town and has called on SANTACO to ensure that its protest action is peaceful and does not interfere with the rights of others.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the violence and anarchy in Cape Town and has called on SANTACO to ensure that its protest action is peaceful and does not interfere with the rights of others.

src: In this regard, we have noted that there were no violent incidents in the last 48-hours.
tgt: In this regard, we have noted that there were no violent incidents in the last 48-hours.

src: However, members of the South African Police Service and other law-enforcement agencies have been directed to ensue violent situation is under control to allow residents safe movement to school, work and their normal daily activities.
tgt: However, members of the South African Police Service and other law-enforcement agencies have been directed to ensue violent situation is under control to allow residents safe movement to school, work and their normal daily activities.

src: Cabinet was also briefed about the City of Cape Town’s imposing of taxi operating conditions which are at variance with both the National Road Traffic, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996) and the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009), which regulate the traffic offences and applicable penalties, including the impounding of vehicles.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed about the City of Cape Town’s imposing of taxi operating conditions which are at variance with both the National Road Traffic, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996) and the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009), which regulate the traffic offences and applicable penalties, including the impounding of vehicles.

src: Cabinet has directed the Minister of Transport, Ms Sindisiwe Chikunga, to ensure that any taxi operating conditions that contradicts the laws of the Republic are removed.
tgt: Cabinet has directed the Minister of Transport, Ms Sindisiwe Chikunga, to ensure that any taxi operating conditions that contradicts the laws of the Republic are removed.

src: Fight against illegal mining.
tgt: Fight against illegal mining.

src: Cabinet welcomed the deployment of a special police unit, which is supported by the military, in Riverlea, Johannesburg, to deal with illegal mining in the area.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the deployment of a special police unit, which is supported by the military, in Riverlea, Johannesburg, to deal with illegal mining in the area.

src: In addition, Cabinet commended the arrest of over 194 suspects over illegal mining activities and directed law-enforcement agencies to urgently clamp down on this and other serious crimes in the country.
tgt: In addition, Cabinet commended the arrest of over 194 suspects over illegal mining activities and directed law-enforcement agencies to urgently clamp down on this and other serious crimes in the country.

src: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) has committed to close all derelict open shafts and mine holes in Riverlea by the end of September 2023, whilst finalising plans to close other derelict open shafts and mining holes across the country.
tgt: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) has committed to close all derelict open shafts and mine holes in Riverlea by the end of September 2023, whilst finalising plans to close other derelict open shafts and mining holes across the country.

src: The security situation in Niger.
tgt: The security situation in Niger.

src: Cabinet has noted the impact the security situation in Niger is having on air-travel between South Africa/Southern Africa and Western Europe, with negative implications for business and individuals alike and the airline industry that is just starting to recover from the devastating ravages of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
tgt: Cabinet has noted the impact the security situation in Niger is having on air-travel between South Africa/Southern Africa and Western Europe, with negative implications for business and individuals alike and the airline industry that is just starting to recover from the devastating ravages of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

src: Cabinet reiterated government’s condemnation of the coup in Niger and the call for the speedy restoration of a democratic order, and also noted the initiative to restore normality under the Economic Community of West African States.
tgt: Cabinet reiterated government’s condemnation of the coup in Niger and the call for the speedy restoration of a democratic order, and also noted the initiative to restore normality under the Economic Community of West African States.

src: Russia-Africa Summit.
tgt: Russia-Africa Summit.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa was amongst other African leaders who attended the Second Russia-Africa Summit, in St Petersburg in the Russian Federation on 27 and 28 July 2023.
tgt: President Cyril Ramaphosa was amongst other African leaders who attended the Second Russia-Africa Summit, in St Petersburg in the Russian Federation on 27 and 28 July 2023.

src: This summit adopted the Russia-Africa Partnership Forum Action Plan which focuses on strengthening cooperation in areas of politics and security, economics, humanitarian matters, and interests of mutual benefit and prosperity.
tgt: This summit adopted the Russia-Africa Partnership Forum Action Plan which focuses on strengthening cooperation in areas of politics and security, economics, humanitarian matters, and interests of mutual benefit and prosperity.

src: On the sidelines of the summit, African Heads of State and Government who are part of the African Peace Initiative on the conflict between Russia and Ukraine held follow-up talks with President Vladimir Putin on the previously discussed confidence-building measures that will create conditions for a negotiated settlement to ending the war.
tgt: On the sidelines of the summit, African Heads of State and Government who are part of the African Peace Initiative on the conflict between Russia and Ukraine held follow-up talks with President Vladimir Putin on the previously discussed confidence-building measures that will create conditions for a negotiated settlement to ending the war.

src: Presidents Ramaphosa and Putin also held a bilateral meeting and discussed opportunities to increase trade between the two countries, and for the Russian Federation to increase investments in South Africa.
tgt: Presidents Ramaphosa and Putin also held a bilateral meeting and discussed opportunities to increase trade between the two countries, and for the Russian Federation to increase investments in South Africa.

src: BRICS Summit Hosting Readiness.
tgt: BRICS Summit Hosting Readiness.

src: Cabinet was apprised that it is all systems go in terms of South Africa’s readiness to host the 15th BRICS Summit in Johannesburg from 22 to 24 August 2023.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised that it is all systems go in terms of South Africa’s readiness to host the 15th BRICS Summit in Johannesburg from 22 to 24 August 2023.

src: The last of the BRICS Ministerial meetings – the BRICS Ministers of Agriculture Meeting – is currently underway, while the Ministerial Meetings of Foreign Affairs, Security, Trade, Industry, Education, Science, Labour, Communications, Health, and Urbanisation Forum have concluded their reports for the Leaders’ Summit.
tgt: The last of the BRICS Ministerial meetings – the BRICS Ministers of Agriculture Meeting – is currently underway, while the Ministerial Meetings of Foreign Affairs, Security, Trade, Industry, Education, Science, Labour, Communications, Health, and Urbanisation Forum have concluded their reports for the Leaders’ Summit.

src: The BRICS Outreach programmes for various sectors and communities have also been concluded.
tgt: The BRICS Outreach programmes for various sectors and communities have also been concluded.

src: These engagements provided governments, organisations, experts and academics from the BRICS nations an opportunity to discuss issues of mutual interest that will enable informed decision-making during the BRICS Summit.
tgt: These engagements provided governments, organisations, experts and academics from the BRICS nations an opportunity to discuss issues of mutual interest that will enable informed decision-making during the BRICS Summit.

src: National Development Plan (NDP) Ten-Year Review.
tgt: National Development Plan (NDP) Ten-Year Review.

src: Cabinet welcomed the Ten-Year Review of the NDP by the National Planning Commission that pointed out that the economy remained structured in a manner that does not serve the interests of all South Africans, which is a major reason behind increasing levels of poverty and inequality.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the Ten-Year Review of the NDP by the National Planning Commission that pointed out that the economy remained structured in a manner that does not serve the interests of all South Africans, which is a major reason behind increasing levels of poverty and inequality.

src: Government remains committed to restructuring and transforming the economy to serve the interests of all South Africans.
tgt: Government remains committed to restructuring and transforming the economy to serve the interests of all South Africans.

src: Energy.
tgt: Energy.

src: The 25th July marked the First Anniversary since President Ramaphosa announced the Energy Action Plan.
tgt: The 25th July marked the First Anniversary since President Ramaphosa announced the Energy Action Plan.

src: Cabinet welcomed the progress made to date to implement the Energy Action Plan, which continues to register an improvement in the Energy Availability Factor and improvement in the stages of load-shedding.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the progress made to date to implement the Energy Action Plan, which continues to register an improvement in the Energy Availability Factor and improvement in the stages of load-shedding.

src: Tourism Cabinet is pleased that the Tourism statistics for June 2023 show that our tourism sector is slowly but surely recovering from the devastating effects of the COVID-19 pandemic.

src: Essential Food Price Monitoring Reports.1 The Competition Commission has been monitoring essential food prices pursuant to price gouging concerns raised since the declaration of the State of Disaster in March 2020.
tgt: Essential Food Price Monitoring Reports.1 The Competition Commission has been monitoring essential food prices pursuant to price gouging concerns raised since the declaration of the State of Disaster in March 2020.

src: The continuation of essential food price monitoring is motivated by the need to ensure affordable and accessible essential food products for consumers.
tgt: The continuation of essential food price monitoring is motivated by the need to ensure affordable and accessible essential food products for consumers.

src: The Commission has noted the ‘rocket and feather’ effect, where prices are quick to rise often in excess of cost increases and slow to fall once cost pressures decline.
tgt: The Commission has noted the ‘rocket and feather’ effect, where prices are quick to rise often in excess of cost increases and slow to fall once cost pressures decline.

src: It has also flagged the concentrated nature of the food and retail markets as a concerning contributing factor.
tgt: It has also flagged the concentrated nature of the food and retail markets as a concerning contributing factor.

src: The Cabinet has noted the Commission’s recommended measures including market inquiries to address structural features in the market that lead to high food prices and low levels of competition.
tgt: The Cabinet has noted the Commission’s recommended measures including market inquiries to address structural features in the market that lead to high food prices and low levels of competition.

src: Cabinet has approved that the Economic Cluster must put in place an action plan on food prices, food secure and access to food.
tgt: Cabinet has approved that the Economic Cluster must put in place an action plan on food prices, food secure and access to food.
